scope_note: Reusable candidate grammar for CERC Sharing supplementary drafts. No literal source dates, amounts, PDF hashes or physical-page selections in match rules. Native unit labels require source-family classification; zero matches are a gap, not absence. Captures are literal atoms, not composed eligibility or activated deadlines.
